authorization: User selected D2; fixture-only reproduction of the five D1 gaps, no application repair or live operations
test_environment: Windows, Python 3.13.15, pytest 9.1.1; report-owned temporary workspaces; existing project virtual environment

tests.skip_reason: Existing outside-workspace symlink test requires Windows symlink privilege
tests.interpretation: Characterization PASS proves the observed gap. It does not certify the behavior as safe.
tests.first_attempt: 50 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped. Windows text-write CRLF translation changed the byte-budget fixture. Corrected only the report-owned fixture to write exact UTF-8 bytes; preserved ATTEMPT_1 evidence.

findings.precondition: Synthetic file x = 1; callback returns a negated clause followed by an unsupported positive storage claim in one sentence
findings.expected_safety: Unsupported positive storage claim rejected regardless of the adjacent negative clause
findings.actual: verification passed, no violations, unsupported claim retained in human answer
findings.cause: Sentence-wide negation check skips all claim checks
findings.impact: Grounding can accept unsupported positive behavior claims
findings.control: Standalone unsupported positive storage claim produces a violation

findings.precondition: Injected synthetic backend returns fabricated outside-workspace path/content for an allowed app/example.py request
findings.expected_safety: Successful result tied to approved requested path and workspace boundary
findings.actual: Foreign read result accepted for analysis; absolute outside find result survives sanitization
findings.cause: Read sanitation validates content type/binary/length but not returned identity; _rel retains outside paths
findings.impact: Conditional trust boundary gap when an external backend is used
findings.control: Direct outside-path request and subsequent outside-path read are blocked before backend invocation
findings.limitation: No actual outside file read; live backend adapter and deployed usage not verified

findings.expected_safety: Search excludes directory names denied by workspace policy
findings.cause: Walk pruning filters skip directories and root data but not sensitive directory names
findings.impact: Sensitive-directory filename metadata can be exposed
findings.control: read_file denies the path; root listing hides secrets; real secrets untouched

findings.precondition: PermissionError injected at os.scandir for one synthetic child directory during real os.walk
findings.expected_safety: Incomplete search exposes traversal failure or uncertainty
findings.actual: success true, matches empty, error null, truncated false despite denied traversal
findings.cause: os.walk has no onerror handler; skipped directory is not reflected in response
findings.impact: An incomplete search can be interpreted as no matching file
findings.limitation: Simulated access error; no Windows ACL changes or live filesystem correlation

findings.precondition: 158-byte read budget for a 192-byte fixture; print call lies beyond read prefix; callback claims no print
findings.expected_safety: Analysis discloses partial source and limits verification scope
findings.actual: Tool truncated true, verification passed, answer claims no print without truncation notice
findings.cause: Analysis ignores truncated flag; truncation notice exists only for verbatim response
findings.impact: Partial-source analysis can produce unqualified absence claims
findings.control: Full fixture read contains print and is not truncated
findings.limitation: Absence-claim acceptance also intersects D2-01; no isolated attribution to truncation alone

effects.network: Blocked except stdlib internal loopback socketpair needed by asyncio
effects.provider_or_model: Provider/model imports blocked; deterministic plain callback only
effects.database: sqlite connections and protected database paths blocked
effects.persistence: AuditTrail in-memory only; writes allowed only under this evidence directory
effects.graph: No edits; graph update intentionally not run under preservation scope

limitations: This is behavioral evidence for local source under fixture conditions; runtime identity, launch configuration, OpenAPI and live integration were not rechecked.
Prior source/runtime registration discrepancy remains unresolved; no restart or automatic repair authorized.
No real provider, model, database, RAG, protected persistence or source execution was used.
Backend-result finding is conditional on injected adapter behavior; it does not prove actual live data disclosure.
Isolation guards are scoped Python harness controls, not an OS sandbox certification.

3489 inventoried source/test/frontend/graph files retain their hashes. Existing Git entries remain, but four additional untracked NUSANTARA-LEVEL-B-RESULT reports appeared outside this D2 evidence directory during verification. This harness did not create them, their producer is unknown, and they were left untouched. Whole-tree identity is therefore not claimed.
Existing five inaccessible Git report directories remain untouched; full Git enumeration has inherited permission warnings.
Symlink runtime behavior remains untested because the existing test was skipped.
